text: Ticket S V one one four two two, on staging. With work orders in Unassigned, the first Tab lands on the first row, with a focus ring.
Searching S two one six six eight eight, Unassigned is empty and the only work order is far down the list. The first Tab lands on the Unassigned header instead.
Once that row is scrolled onto the screen, Tab lands on it. So only an off-screen row is missed.
Board View does the same: its card is off to the right, and Tab lands on the Unassigned column header. This part still needs a fix.
